title: Comparative Metabolomics Identifies Diterpene-Rich Marine Macroalgae with Potent Antiproliferative Activity Against Colorectal Cancer Cells.

title: Bladder Sensory Neurons as Regulators of Neuro-Immune-Urothelial Interactions: From Molecular Mechanisms to Targeted Therapy for Neurogenic Bladder and Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome.
snippet: Bladder sensory neurons are essential components of lower urinary tract sensory encoding and micturition reflex control.
